```plato
    // The endpoint of an undirected edge that is NOT the given vertex.
    // Precondition: the vertex is one of the edge's two endpoints.
    OtherEndOfUndirectedEdge(self: IMeshIncidence, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex, vertex: VertexIndex): VertexIndex
    {
        var endpoints = self.VerticesOfUndirectedEdge(edge);
        return endpoints.A.Equals(vertex) ? endpoints.B : endpoints.A;
    }
```
